english.note: Use this relative-clause restructuring when B, the possessor's noun, is involved in the clause V; for example, 隻狗搞出意外嗰個男人 means “the man whose dog caused the accident.”

examples.english: I saw the man whose dog bit someone.
examples.traditional: 我見過隻狗咬親人嗰個男人。
